prespecification.acceptance: All seven Bonferroni-adjusted crossed-bootstrap interval conditions must pass; zero independent authorization violations are also mandatory.
prespecification.fairness: All non-oracle selectors receive the identical Observation object and action budget; legacy selectors deliberately project it to their original features. No policy sees case ID, seed, latent states, actual shifted error rates or future random draws.
prespecification.hypothesis: Contextual selection improves IID mean utility by more than 0.01 over each of cost_rule, rules_repair and always_verify while satisfying safety criteria.
prespecification.inference: Paired case differences, then balanced training x evaluation-seed cell means; resample training replicas and evaluation clusters independently with replacement. Cases reused across models and fixed baselines are not independent replicates.
prespecification.null: At least one utility improvement is <=0.01, operational risk exceeds 0.05, or excess risk versus a primary baseline exceeds 0.005.
prespecification.oracle: Unattainable hindsight simulator oracle sees all realized allowed potential outcomes, including random draws, but has the same action budget and mandatory access checks.
prespecification.primary_outcome: Mean value*completion - harm*unsafe - intervention/time cost over ALL IID cases.
prespecification.safety: Unsafe operational completion is distinct from forbidden execution. Risk score thresholds and bootstrap intervals are not security or population safety guarantees.
prespecification.secondary: Per-domain/profile results, calibration, ablations, regret and ordinary 95% intervals are descriptive without multiplicity correction.
prespecification.selection: One fixed model specification per independent training seed; no development hyperparameter search. Development is a diagnostic freeze, not training data.
prespecification.stopping: Run all declared seeds and profiles once; keep every case. No optional stopping, no final-driven tuning. Revised hypotheses require a new protocol and final seeds.
prespecification.training: Full synthetic potential outcomes for all arms; not logged-bandit causal identification. Separate calibration seeds fit isotonic maps; no evaluation labels enter fitting.
